thread:
jess: Quick docs bug — the API ref for GET /v1/embeddings with pagination is inconsistent. The request example uses `pagesize` while the schema (and the actual endpoint) uses `page_size`. Also the response example shows `items` as an object with keyed ids, but the service returns an array. Found while testing a migration.

matt: Ugh, thanks for catching. Can you paste the current example + the live response you saw?

jess: Current (bad) example in docs:
```json
GET /v1/embeddings?page=1&pagesize=10
{
  "items": {
    "id_1": {"embedding": [0.1, 0.2]},
    "id_2": {"embedding": [0.3, 0.4]}
  },
  "next_page": 2
}
```
Live response I got:
```json
{
  "items": [
    {"id": "id_1", "embedding": [0.1, 0.2]},
    {"id": "id_2", "embedding": [0.3, 0.4]}
  ],
  "next_page": 2
}
```

sanjay: Yep — SDKs expect `page_size` (snake_case). JS client was silently mapping `pageSize` -> `page_size` but curl examples are confusing customers. We should update the OpenAPI examples + the generated Python/JS snippets.

alex: I can tackle this. Plan:
- Update OpenAPI request example to use `page_size` and a short note about `page` indexing
- Swap response example to an array shape
- Regenerate docs snippets (python/js) and add a tiny migration note under the embeddings section

matt: Sounds good. Add a unit test in the docs PR that asserts example roundtrips? At least add a `<!-- verify: real-api-check -->` comment so we can run our doc validator later.

alex: Will do. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4721 — contains the OpenAPI snippet change + regenerated SDK examples. Marked it as WIP.

docs-bot: PR #4721 created by alex — "embeds: fix pagination param casing and response example" :white_check_mark:

sanjay: Quick nit — in the Python snippet we should keep `page_size` consistently and not mix with `limit`. Also ensure the example uses `items[0]["embedding"]` access for array form.

alex: Good catch, fixed in PR. Updated both curl and python/js examples.

jess: Thanks — can someone review? This is a small but confusing mismatch and it's tripping enterprise customers doing schema validation.

matt: Reviewing now.

matt: LGTM, no blockers. Added the verify comment and a tiny migration note: "If you previously parsed `items` as an object by id, update to array form and use `id` field inside each item." :thumbsup:

alex: Merged and deployed to staging. Release note queued: "docs: embeddings pagination example param name and response shape corrected." :shipit:

jess: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll ping support to close a couple of related tickets.

sanjay: :eyes: good follow-up — maybe add a short migration snippet for Go SDK too later.

alex: I'll open a follow-up PR for Go examples after we confirm snippet generator output.

jess: Closing thread, feel free to reopen if anything pops up.
